entries.title: Exodus 25:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

entries.title: Exodus 25:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring Me an offering. From everyone who gives it willingly with his heart you shall take My offering.

entries.title: Exodus 25:3
segments: "And this [is] the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, and bronze;

entries.title: Exodus 25:4
segments: "blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], fine linen, and goats' [hair];

entries.title: Exodus 25:5
segments: "ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;

entries.title: Exodus 25:6
segments: "oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;

entries.title: Exodus 25:7
segments: "onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.

entries.title: Exodus 25:8
segments: "And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:9
segments: "According to all that I show you, [that is], the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furnishings, just so you shall make [it].

entries.title: Exodus 25:10
segments: ¶"And they shall make an ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits [shall be] its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

entries.title: Exodus 25:11
segments: "And you shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and out you shall overlay it, and shall make on it a molding of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:12
segments: "You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put [them] in its four corners; two rings [shall be] on one side, and two rings on the other side.

entries.title: Exodus 25:13
segments: "And you shall make poles [of] acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:14
segments: "You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, that the ark may be carried by them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:15
segments: "The poles shall be in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:16
segments: "And you shall put into the ark the Testimony which I will give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:17
segments: "You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits [shall be] its length and a cubit and a half its width.

entries.title: Exodus 25:18
segments: "And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work you shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 25:19
segments: "Make one cherub at one end, and the other cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim at the two ends of it [of one piece] with the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 25:20
segments: "And the cherubim shall stretch out [their] wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and they shall face one another; the faces of the cherubim [shall be] toward the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 25:21
segments: "You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the Testimony that I will give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:22
segments: "And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which [are] on the ark of the Testimony, about everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 25:23
segments: ¶"You shall also make a table of acacia wood; two cubits [shall be] its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

entries.title: Exodus 25:24
segments: "And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:25
segments: "You shall make for it a frame of a handbreadth all around, and you shall make a gold molding for the frame all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:26
segments: "And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that [are] at its four legs.

entries.title: Exodus 25:27
segments: "The rings shall be close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.

entries.title: Exodus 25:28
segments: "And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:29
segments: "You shall make its dishes, its pans, its pitchers, and its bowls for pouring. You shall make them of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:30
segments: "And you shall set the showbread on the table before Me always.

entries.title: Exodus 25:31
segments: ¶"You shall also make a lampstand of pure gold; the lampstand shall be of hammered work. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its [ornamental] knobs, and flowers shall be [of one piece].

entries.title: Exodus 25:32
segments: "And six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.

entries.title: Exodus 25:33
segments: "Three bowls [shall be] made like almond [blossoms] on one branch, [with] an [ornamental] knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond [blossoms]  on the other branch, [with] an [ornamental] knob and a flower-and so for the six branches that come out of the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 25:34
segments: "On the lampstand itself four bowls [shall be] made like almond [blossoms, each with] its [ornamental] knob and flower.

entries.title: Exodus 25:35
segments: "And [there shall be] a knob under the [first] two branches of the same, a knob under the [second] two branches of the same, and a knob under the [third] two branches of the same, according to the six branches that extend from the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 25:36
segments: "Their knobs and their branches [shall be of one piece]; all of it [shall be] one hammered piece of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:37
segments: "You shall make seven lamps for it, and they shall arrange its lamps so that they give light in front of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:38
segments: "And its wick-trimmers and their trays [shall be] of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:39
segments: "It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.

entries.title: Exodus 25:40
segments: "And see to it that you make [them] according to the pattern which was shown you on the mountain.
